comparison.objective: Select and install a matching driver bit, power-tighten a drawer knob, and return the tool.
comparison.physical_skill: Bit-shape selection, removable-bit insertion, powered screw engagement, drawer bracing, and tool placement.
comparison.success_condition: Cross bit retained; at least 1.3 mm powered screw feed; knob gap at most 0.2 mm; withstand 5 N; stopped driver released stably in stand.
comparison.reason: The candidate commissions damping by unlocking and rotating a collar, relocking it, and evaluating repeated dynamic stops. Powered fastening and bit installation test a different mechanism and outcome.
